chunk_by_title_semantic_blob module

By-Title Semantic Chunker for Azure

Features:

Removes document noise (headers, footers, page numbers, doc numbers) Keeps all meaningful data intact Correct page numbers Clean metadata: source_document, project_name, page Works with Azure Blob Storage

Usage:

from chunk_by_title_semantic_blob import DocumentChunker chunker = DocumentChunker() chunks = chunker.process_all_projects() chunker.save_chunks()
